{{Quote|The cables are coated with protective rubber, so they won't cut you. It'll be sort of like climbing a wall covered with ivy.|Captain Hajj|<ref name="TDDS">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Doomsday Ship]]''</ref>}}
'''Ivy''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Innton II]], [[Kiamurr]] and [[Talasea]] as well as a [[Ivy moon of Bogden|moon]] of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]] and the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ithorian Herdship|herdship]] ''[[Tafanda Bay]]''.

== Description ==
Ivy was known for its ability to cling to<ref name="HAT"/> and climb across surfaces<ref name="PoD"/> as well as hang from them.<ref name="Strongholds"/> A type with leaves could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiamurr]]<ref name="HAT"/> and a dark [[Color/Legends|green]] variety grew on [[Talasea]].<ref name="XW:RS"/> Another type with gold leaves was kept aboard the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ithorian Herdship|herdship]] ''[[Tafanda Bay]]''.<ref name="DT2"/>

== History ==

In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], while visiting the [[Temple of the Ancients]] on the planet [[Rakata Prime|Lehon]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] noted that the structure was bare of [[Moss/Legends|moss]] and ivy.<ref name="PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="BF1 Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> while scouting the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] eliminated one [[Ivy moon of Bogden|moon]] as a place to land his [[Slave I/Legends|ship]] since it was covered in ivy that looked [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]].<ref name="BF1"/> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TDDS Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Doomsday Ship]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> while preparing to go up a cable pipe with [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hajj]] compared the excursion to climbing a wall covered in ivy.<ref name="TDDS"/> The entrance to the large [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] on<ref name="Strongholds" />  the planet<ref name="FFG">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/9/22/outer-rim-and-defiant-core|text=Outer Rim and Defiant Core}}</ref> [[Innton II]], which contained the [[Defiant Core]] base, was concealed by ivy and other vegetation.<ref name="Strongholds"/> Between [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="HAT Date">{{Facebook|username=starwarsbooks|url=photo.php?fbid=10151201849798713&set=a.414408798712.177165.67519418712&type=1&theater|name=Star Wars Books|date=October 12, 2012|archivedate=20200820080921}}</ref> while on approach to [[Kiamurr]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] saw plants clinging to the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] like ivy to a wall. Han also noticed [[Stone/Legends|stone]]-and-ivy terraces in the planet's [[Talastin City]]; later, while waiting in an atrium, Solo counted the leaves on nearby [[Fern (plant)/Legends|ferns]] and ivy.<ref name="HAT" />

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]],<ref name="XW:RS Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]'' to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].</ref> while visiting the planet [[Talasea]] with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to establish a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Talasea base|base]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] noticed ivy growing all over the local buildings.<ref name="XW:RS" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="XW:TKT Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]'' to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].</ref> while observing the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sienn'rha]] dancing, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] thought the way her [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] enveloped her like ivy.<ref name="XW:TKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="XW:IR Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]'' to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].</ref> during the [[Battle of Liinade III]], Antilles saw the New Republic [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Freedom]]'' pummel the [[Ciutric Hegemony]]'s [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Direption]]'' with [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] fire, with several bolts spreading across the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]'s [[Hull/Legends|hull]] and joining together like ivy to grow up over the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="XW:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> In [[25 ABY]],<ref name="DT2 Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]'' to [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].</ref> Horn and Antilles observed a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] form of scanning technology that looked like growths spreading out in an ivy-like pattern. While aboard the ''Tafanda Bay'' that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Anakin Solo]] saw ivy running along the ceiling of a corridor.<ref name="DT2" />

== Behind the scenes ==
Ivy first appeared in [[Michael A. Stackpole]]'s [[1996]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''.<ref name="XW:RS" />
